title: Unlock Your Potential With AI By Joining This Free Virtual Summit Connecting You With Tools And The Industry's Best - NewsBreak
text: Be a part of the AI revolution. Whether you are a creative leaning into AI for content creation, a marketing lead leveraging it for fresh ideas, or a founder looking to make an industry more efficient, AI Edge is your next step forward. This free virtual summit, to be held on Aug. 8, will connect you with top tools to become more efficient as well as offer firsthand insights from leading AI adopters and industry experts including Alicia Lyttle ( CEO and co-founder at AI InnoVision), ​​Vanessa Schneider (head of marketing at Descript), and more. Programming will include: A survey of 1,491 AFROTECH corporate professionals, entrepreneurs, students, solopreneurs, and small business owners shows that a shift is already happening. In fact, 96.6% of the respondents are using ChatGPT, compared to just 23% of the general population. Additionally, 8% of professionals nationwide report using AI regularly in comparison to 60.8% of AFROTECH professionals who have already integrated AI into their daily workflows. However, AFROTECH Co-Founder and CEO Morgan DeBaun believes that number should be even higher. “Did you know that only 60% of AFROTECH techies use AI daily. I’m not judging you, but I am judging you a little bit because it should be 100% of you,” DeBaun said in a video shared on Instagram. “So, we’re doing a free training, a free summit called AI Edge and I want you there. It’s going to give you all the tools, the information from some of the best people in the game so that you can learn how to integrate AI into your work, into your life. Workforce readiness and AI scaling is one of the top things that these companies are looking for, and I want you guys to make as much money as possible.” For those interested in attending the AI Edge Virtual Summit, you can register here.
